pNone_chapter_1: In a dimly lit, high-ceilinged room of a grand Bengali estate, Byomkesh Bakshi and Ajit Bandyopadhyay sit in ornate wooden chairs across from Kumar Tridib. Byomkesh, lean and sharp-eyed in a crisp white dhoti-kurta, leans forward with an engaged expression while Ajit sits beside him, listening intently. A warm, amber glow from a tabletop lantern casts long shadows against the heavy drapes and antique bookshelves in the background. The atmosphere is thick with the quiet comfort of a cold December evening following a large meal. Tridib stands near the doorway, gesturing toward the outdoors as they discuss the plans for the coming morning.
